evals.prompt: Set up our team wiki — create a welcome page and a partner guide on Lark (two legs).
evals.expected_output: The skill should parse this as a multi-backend wiki setup, search for collisions, present a unified proposal for both pages, and upon approval create both with native URL confirmations.
expectations: The skill identifies 2 pages: welcome and partner guide (both lark legs)
The skill searches each backend for existing documents with similar titles
A unified proposal is shown listing all legs before any write
The user is asked to confirm before any write executes
Both kgent create calls are executed after approval
The confirmation includes native URLs for both backends
The op_id is reported for undo capability
evals.notes: DingTalk legs return in Phase 2 (dingtalk-integration 未实施); two Lark legs keep the multi-leg orchestration coverage

evals.prompt: Create home pages for the new project on Lark (two pages, two legs).
evals.expected_output: The skill should search for existing project home pages. If found, propose UPDATE instead of CREATE. Show per-leg status in the proposal.
expectations: The skill searches both lark and dingtalk for existing 'home' or 'project' pages
If a match is found on either backend, the skill proposes UPDATE for that leg
The unified proposal shows operation type (CREATE or UPDATE) per leg
The user is asked to confirm before any write
Native URLs in the confirmation, not kgent:// URIs
If a collision is found, the existing document title is shown
evals.notes: DingTalk legs return in Phase 2 (dingtalk-integration 未实施); two Lark legs keep the multi-leg orchestration coverage

evals.prompt: Initialize our knowledge base with documentation on Lark, DingTalk, and WeCom.
evals.expected_output: The skill should create documentation pages on all 3 backends. If one fails, the others should still succeed (partial success). Failed legs should be reported as repairable.
expectations: The proposal lists all 3 backends as targets
The user confirms before any write
Each backend is attempted independently
If one backend fails, the skill reports the failure with the specific error
Successful backends are confirmed with native URLs
Failed legs mention repairability via 'kgent sync --repair <op_id>'
The op_id is reported for the overall operation
evals.notes: DingTalk legs return in Phase 2 (dingtalk-integration 未实施); two Lark legs keep the multi-leg orchestration coverage

evals.prompt: I want to set up a FAQ page. Create it on Lark first, then we'll see about other backends.
evals.expected_output: The skill should respect the user's incremental approach — create on Lark only for now, and mention that additional backends can be added later.
expectations: The skill targets only lark (as the user specified)
The skill does NOT create on other backends without explicit confirmation
The proposal is shown and confirmed before write
The confirmation includes a native Lark URL
The skill mentions that additional backends can be added later
The op_id is reported for undo
evals.notes: DingTalk legs return in Phase 2 (dingtalk-integration 未实施); two Lark legs keep the multi-leg orchestration coverage

evals.prompt: Create 3 wiki pages: 'Getting Started', 'API Reference', and 'Troubleshooting'. All on Lark.
evals.expected_output: The skill should create all 3 pages on lark, show a unified proposal listing all 3, execute them, and report all 3 native URLs.
expectations: The proposal lists all 3 pages with their titles and the target backend (lark)
The skill searches lark for existing pages with these titles
The user is asked to confirm before any write
All 3 pages are created (or updated if matches exist)
The confirmation shows native URLs for all 3 pages
If any page fails, the others still succeed
The op_id is reported
evals.notes: DingTalk legs return in Phase 2 (dingtalk-integration 未实施); two Lark legs keep the multi-leg orchestration coverage

evals.prompt: We need to set up documentation across all our backends. I have a global config at ~/.kgent/config.yaml.
evals.expected_output: The skill should read the config to discover enabled backends, propose creating docs on each, and execute after confirmation. Should handle the case where workspace_domain is or isn't configured.
expectations: The skill reads ~/.kgent/config.yaml to discover enabled backends
The proposal lists all enabled backends as targets
The skill asks the user what content/pages to create (or proposes defaults)
If workspace_domain is configured, native URLs are shown
If workspace_domain is NOT configured, the skill tells the user to configure it (S75)
The user confirms before any write
The op_id is reported
evals.notes: DingTalk legs return in Phase 2 (dingtalk-integration 未实施); two Lark legs keep the multi-leg orchestration coverage
